# Mersinli Tantuni by Choban

Mersin style tantuni in Norwich, UK. All our meat is halal.

Address: 1 Exeter Street, Norwich NR2 4QB
Open: Sunday to Thursday 10am to 10pm, Friday and Saturday 10am to 11pm
Menu: halal chicken, or mixed beef and lamb tantuni, both £6.50, as a dürüm wrap or a plate. Vegetarian gözleme with feta cheese, cheese and parsley, £4.50. Drinks £1.50 (şalgam, ayran, Fanta Orange, Fanta Lemon, Hayat water).
Payment: cash when you collect. Online card payment is coming soon.
Order: https://mersinlitantuni.co.uk/menu
Allergens: https://mersinlitantuni.co.uk/menu#allergens (tantuni and gözleme contain wheat, gözleme and ayran contain milk, şalgam contains wheat)

Tantuni is a street food from Mersin, Turkey. Finely chopped meat is simmered, fried on a sac pan with chilli flakes and rolled in thin lavash with tomato, sumac onions and parsley.
